mission: New-sources plan step S1 (owner approved the plan 2026-10-19 00:34Z): one additive migration 7a52e9b48e8a on 3b7d9c1a5e20. Adds nullable price_observations.grade_key with a vocabulary CHECK and a raw-only CHECK (PSA10 OFF, decision N10), both NOT VALID then validated; widens the proposal-group candidate-type CHECK with source_product; creates empty source_product_groups, source_products, source_product_variants, source_variant_renderings, market_index_splices and market_index_splice_snapshots; seeds inert dorasuta and cardrush source rows. ORM for the new tables lives in app.source_products, which nothing in app.models imports, so neither existing collector loads it. Staging only; no collector, rollout, source request, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change. The owner applies the migration by hand after merging (alembic upgrade head, backup under 24 h).

impacts.reason: Additive DDL: six new empty tables, one nullable column on price_observations (metadata-only in PostgreSQL 16), two CHECKs added NOT VALID then VALIDATE (a scan under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, which does not block reads or writes; every existing row is NULL), one CHECK widened, two sources rows inserted if absent. Downgrade refuses while any new table or grade_key holds data.

New package with the grade_key vocabulary and ORM for the new tables. Not imported by app.models or any existing module, so no API, worker or collector code path changes; verified outside both collector runtime inputs (scripts/collector_runtime_inputs.py).

Migration upgrade, constraint, model-parity and refusing-downgrade tests; the accounts migration test now pins its own revision instead of head; plan §2.7 guard that new-source paths stay outside the Yuyu-Tei and SNKRDUNK runtime inputs.

dependencies: Alembic head 3b7d9c1a5e20 (collector account tables); new-sources plan on branch plan/new-sources (d0bd629); S0 diagnostics PR #178 independent
impact.deployment_impact: API and worker redeploy with an unused new package; no code path reads it. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts. The receipt fails on the migration revision until the owner runs alembic upgrade head, the documented signal.

recovery.procedure: While the new tables and grade_key are empty: alembic downgrade 3b7d9c1a5e20 (it refuses otherwise), then a native revert of this PR. The two inert sources rows stay.
recovery.trigger: Migration fails or exceeds its lock budget, API or worker fails to start, or any existing collector or diagnostic errors on the changed schema.
recovery.backup: Railway Postgres backup younger than 24 h before the owner runs the migration (scripts/staging_backup_age.py).

verification.observation_window: After the owner applies the migration: Verify staging merge passes on revision 7a52e9b48e8a, and the next yuyutei and snkrdunk collector runs and one staging-state run complete as before.
